title: ThinkSort: Brain Dump Planner
shortDescription: Dump everything on your mind. Get one clear next step. Private and offline.
fullDescription:
Twelve things in your head, all of them urgent, and no idea where to start? ThinkSort gives you one place to empty it all out and one clear answer to the only question that matters: what do I do right now?

BRAIN DUMP, NOT DATA ENTRY
Speak or type one long, messy ramble. ThinkSort sorts it into dated tasks, prep items, shopping and ideas, then shows you a confirm screen before anything is saved. Nothing is stored until you say so.

IT NEVER GUESSES
The organizer is rule-based and runs entirely on your phone. It won't invent dates, times or places. If something is unclear, it becomes a short question you answer yourself, so your list stays true to what you actually said.

ONE NEXT THING
The Today screen shows a single NEXT UP card with a plain-language reason why it's next. Start it, finish it, push it to later, or tap I'm Stuck. One Thing Mode hides everything else when even a short list feels like too much.

WHEN YOU FREEZE
I'm Stuck asks what is making the task hard and hands back one tiny first step. Where I Left Off recaps what you were doing before you got pulled away, so you don't have to rebuild the context from scratch.

FOCUS AND FOLLOW-THROUGH
A built-in focus timer with 5, 15, 25 or custom minutes keeps you on one task at a time. Shopping lists group by store with one-tap check-off. Morning and evening check-ins, Upcoming, Notes and Search are there when you want the bigger picture.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Reminders respect your quiet hours and come back after your phone restarts. You choose what gets a nudge.

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
No account. No cloud. No analytics. No ads. Everything you write stays on your phone, and every permission is optional.

TRY IT FREE, THEN BUY IT ONCE
ThinkSort is free for your first 7 days - the whole app, nothing locked. After that, one purchase unlocks it for good. No subscription, no monthly fee, no upgrade nagging.

Built for people juggling too many open loops - adults with ADHD or executive-function struggles, and anyone who is simply overwhelmed. ThinkSort is an organization tool, not a health product: it does not assess, diagnose or treat anything. It just holds your list and points at the next step.

Dump your head out. Get one thing to do.
releaseNotes: First Android release of ThinkSort: brain dump, one next step, I'm Stuck, focus timer, shopping lists and gentle reminders. Free for 7 days, then one purchase.
